description: Requires the account session, current X-Organization-Id and CSRF for writes. Enable or stop domain monitoring, or pause notices for maintenance. Uses existing rights; 402 supplies checkout instructions and never buys automatically. Stopping a monitor does not cancel a subscription. Activation requires a current domain benefit, a preserved prepaid watch benefit or the account trial. Count a registry domain once per account, including its organization copies. Add only the tab's origin. HTTP receives DNS checks only. Stopping monitoring keeps history and does not cancel a subscription. Maintenance pauses notices while collection continues. Confirm enabled, no suspension and next_check_at after saving.

enabled.description: True enables collection; false stops it.

maintenance_until.description: Future Unix milliseconds within 30 days, or null.

revision.description: Current revision from the corresponding settings or monitor. Use zero for the first change.
